17.description: Charlene mocks Dicky by implying he will need drugs for his back now that he is out.
evidence: CHARLENE I'm sure you'll need somethin' for your back now that you're out.

17.name: Dicky demands equal treatment
17.description: Dicky argues that if O'Keefe can be present despite his own problems, Dicky should be allowed in because he is family.
evidence: O'Keefe's in the same boat I am, one day at a time, why's it all right for him to be here, but not me? I'm blood.

17.name: Micky rejects outside interference
17.description: Micky insists that he is the one fighting and that he alone knows what he needs.
evidence: MICKY I'm the one fighting, not you, not you, and not YOU. I know what I need.

17.name: Charlene questions Micky's need for Dicky
17.description: Charlene challenges Micky by asking whether he really needs Dicky involved.
evidence: CHARLENE (GETS SHRILL) And you need Dicky?

17.name: Micky chooses family support
17.description: After the confrontation, Micky decides he wants Dicky, Charlene, O'Keefe, and his family around him.
evidence: Micky roils as he makes this decision.
MICKY I want Dicky back. And I want you, Charlene, and I want O'Keefe, and my family.

17.name: Charlene rejects Micky
17.description: Charlene tells Micky he cannot treat them that way and suggests he belongs with the people he is sounding like.
evidence: CHARLENE You can't do that to us.
MICKY You sound like them now.
CHARLENE Maybe you're just like them and that's where you belong.

17.name: Charlene leaves the gym
17.description: Charlene turns and walks out of the gym, with O'Keefe following her out and looking back sadly at Micky.
evidence: She looks at him, turns and walks out of the gym, followed by O'Keefe, who looks sadly back at Micky.

17.name: Alice frames the breakup as fate
17.description: Alice comforts Micky by saying that everything happens for a reason and this may be for the best.
evidence: ALICE Everything happens for a reason, this could be for the best, honey.

17.name: Dicky gets geared up for sparring
17.description: Micky watches Dicky being fitted with boxing gear by Art Ramalho before the brothers square off.
evidence: Micky watches Dicky get geared up with gloves, headgear, mouth guard by Art Ramalho.
ANOTHER BOXER gears up Micky.
This rankles Micky as he and Dicky square off.

17.name: Dicky boasts about jail training
17.description: Dicky announces that he trained in jail, signaling he is ready to spar.
evidence: DICKY I was trainin' in jail, so I'm ready.

17.name: Brothers spar aggressively
17.description: Dicky and Micky spar hard, quickly falling back into their combative brotherly dynamic as others watch.
evidence: The two brothers spar, falling right back into it as Alice, George, others watch.

17.name: Dicky lands a head combination
17.description: Dicky moves around the ring and snaps Micky's head with a combination.
evidence: Dicky moving around the ring... He snaps Micky's head with a combination.

17.name: Micky answers with body shots
17.description: Micky retaliates by hammering Dicky with body shots.
evidence: Micky starts banging him with body shots...Bam! Bam! Bam!...

17.name: Dicky evades and jabs
17.description: Dicky tries to make Micky miss, then pushes him away, ducks, and jabs.
evidence: Dicky tries to make Micky miss.
Micky grabs him tying him up.. .Dicky pushes Micky away, ducks, jabs.. .

17.name: Micky traps Dicky's arm
17.description: Micky ties Dicky up and traps his left arm under his elbow, turning him in the ring.
evidence: Micky grabs him tying him up.. .
Micky traps Dicky's left under his elbow/arm, pulling it. . .Turning Dicky so his back

18.name: Dicky returns to the crack house
18.description: Dicky walks down the street toward the crack house, greeting people he knows as he approaches.
evidence: Dicky walks down the street, waves to familiar Cambodian faces and others. Approaches the crack house.

18.name: Crackheads greet Dicky's return
18.description: BooBoo, Wolfie, and Karen recognize Dicky and shout that he is back.
evidence: BooBoo, Wolfie, some other crackheads hanging out front. BOOBOO, WOLFIE, KAREN (see Dicky, shout) Dicky's back! Hey, Dicky!

18.name: Dicky runs away from the crack house
18.description: After hesitating and looking back at the house, Dicky suddenly breaks into a run down the street.
evidence: Dicky limps toward them, slows down, looks at BooBoo, the house behind then continues to walk-then starts to run. Dicky running down the street...

18.name: Dicky demands to see Charlene
18.description: Dicky arrives at Charlene's apartment building and repeatedly buzzes her until she answers.
evidence: CHARLENE'S APARTMENT BUILDING - LATE AFTERNOON Dicky pushes the buzzer, sweat dripping.
DICKY (INTO INTERCOM) Charlene, it's Dicky.
CHARLENE Get off my porch, you piece of shit.
Dicky presses the buzzer and won't stop.

18.name: Charlene confronts Dicky at the door
18.description: Charlene opens the door and meets Dicky in a tense confrontation as he pleads to make things right.
evidence: FRONT DOOR, CHARLENE'S APARTMENT - LATE AFTERNOON Charlene opening her door...Dicky standing in the doorway, sweating, agitated.
DICKY I know you can't fuckin' stand me.
CHARLENE Really? What makes ya say that?
DICKY I got no use for you eithah, but my bruthah loves ya and ya can't walk away 'cause a me. He don't deserve that. If you want me to quit, I'll quit.
DICKY Sweah to God, I'll quit if it makes you go back. Micky's got a chance to do somethin' I nevah did -
DICKY Fuck you, Charlene. I came here to make things right -

18.name: Charlene mocks Dicky's boxing claims
18.description: Charlene mocks Dicky's self-importance and challenges his version of the Sugar Ray Leonard fight.
evidence: CHARLENE (MOCKING) Oh, the Sugah Ray Leonahd fight was my chance, I was great, I fought Sugah Ray Leonahd---
CHARLENE OK, let's make things right, numbah one: Ya didn't knock down Sugah Ray Leonahd, he tripped.

18.name: Dicky defends his boxing experience
18.description: Dicky angrily reminds Charlene that he fought Sugar Ray Leonard and questions what she has accomplished.
evidence: I was in the fuckin' ring with 'im, Chalene, don't you think I know what happened?
But I went ten rounds with Sugar Ray Leonard, what the fuck have you evah done?

18.name: Charlene admits life without Micky feels empty
18.description: Charlene says that her life without Micky sucks and that she loves him and wants him to have his chance.
evidence: Maybe, the part without Micky sucks.
Maybe I never did anything special like you, but I love Micky and I want him to have his chance.

18.name: Dicky and Charlene agree to stop fighting
18.description: Dicky tells Charlene to leave him alone and both agree to spare Micky from their bullshit.
evidence: Then leave me alone.
He needs me, you heard him, and I know he needs you, so let's spare him the bullshit from either one of us.
OK. I'll see ya in Micky's corner, otherwise go fuck yourself.

18.name: Dicky leaves the porch
18.description: After the truce, Dicky walks off the porch.
evidence: Dicky nods, walks off the porch.

18.name: Micky arrives and sees Dicky leaving
18.description: Micky pulls up at Charlene's apartment building and notices Dicky leaving.
evidence: Micky slams the door of his car, walks to see: Dicky leaving.

18.name: Micky questions Dicky's visit
18.description: Surprised, Micky asks Dicky what he is doing there.
evidence: MICKY (SURPRISED) - What the hell are you doin' here?

18.name: Dicky says they worked it out for Micky
18.description: Dicky tells Micky that he and Charlene have resolved their conflict for Micky's sake.
evidence: We worked it out fah you. Ask her. It's all together.

18.name: Micky confirms the reconciliation
18.description: Micky looks to Charlene, sees her nod, and accepts that the situation is settled.
evidence: Micky looks up and sees Charlene standing in the door. She nods.
He looks at Dicky. MICKY Good.

18.name: Micky asks for O'Keefe to return
18.description: Micky tells Dicky to bring O'Keefe back as well, extending the reconciliation to his team.
evidence: Get O'Keefe back, too.

18.name: Micky heads toward Charlene
18.description: After settling matters with Dicky, Micky moves toward Charlene.
evidence: Micky nods, heads toward Charlene.
